slides.headline: WE PASTED 6 PROMPTS INTO CLAUDE AND REPLACED OUR $5,000-A-MONTH MARKETING AGENCY OVERNIGHT
1) FILL A MONTH OF SOCIAL MEDIA IN SECONDS
slides.body: A social media manager costs $4,000 a month. 'Create a 30-day content calendar for [business]. Mix teaching posts, behind-the-scenes, customer wins, and soft sells. One caption per day'

slides.headline: 2) WRITE ADS STRANGERS ACTUALLY CLICK
slides.body: A copywriter charges $150 per ad. 'Write 5 ad variations for [product]. Each one: name a problem the buyer has, make it feel urgent, offer [product] as the fix. Under 30 words'

slides.headline: 3) WRITE BLOG POSTS GOOGLE ACTUALLY RANKS
slides.body: SEO writers charge $500 a post. 'Write a 1,500-word blog targeting [keyword]. Start with a hook, use 5 subheadings that answer real questions people search, end with a call to action'

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A 7-DAY EMAIL SEQUENCE THAT SELLS
slides.body: Agencies charge $2,000 for this. Email returns $36 per $1. 'Write a 7-email sequence for [product]. Start with pain, build trust, end with a deadline. 150 words each'

slides.headline: 5) SEND COLD EMAILS PEOPLE ANSWER
slides.body: Outreach agencies charge $3,000 a month. 'Write a 3-email cold sequence for [product]. First email: compliment something specific about their company, connect it to a problem you solve. Under 80 words'

slides.headline: 6) BUILD YOUR ENTIRE BRAND VOICE FROM SCRATCH
slides.body: Brand consultants charge $10,000 for this. 'Create a brand voice guide for [business]. Include a one-line pitch, 3 brand values with example sentences, and 5 sample posts showing the voice'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR WHEN YOU NEED IT
slides.body: Every prompt works tonight. Paste it into ChatGPT or Claude, swap the brackets for your details. Daily AI skills you can actually use

caption:
Swipe to steal them. Six prompts that handle your ads, emails, blog posts, social media, outreach, and brand voice for $0 🔥

A 30-day social media calendar in one message, Facebook ad copy that follows problem-agitate-solve, SEO blog posts with real keyword targeting, a 7-email sales sequence with built-in deadlines, cold outreach emails written to get replies not silence, and a full brand voice guide with your elevator pitch and sample posts included.

The latest AI models write marketing copy that genuinely competes with agency work. A year ago these prompts gave you filler. Now they give you campaigns you would have paid thousands for.
